files.description:
Description: A recording of a metal chain rattling. The sound is sharp and metallic, capturing the clinking and dragging of heavy links in motion.

This sound is suitable for machinery, dungeon atmospheres, and action scenes in games and films.

Technical details:
Recorder: Zoom Н5
Microphone: EM 25
files.author: KVV_Audio
